name: SwitchBot Lock Pro Matter Enabled (EU)

radios.note: Built-in Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth for close-range unlocking.

matter.note: SwitchBot's Matter page lists the Lock Pro Matter Enabled under Matter over Wi-Fi (lock and unlock). No CSA listing was opened.

apple_home.note: The product page also says a home hub such as a HomePod mini is needed for Apple Home.

google_home.note: The page lists Google Home without saying how it connects; Matter over Wi-Fi is the documented path.

alexa.note: The page lists Alexa without saying how it connects; Matter over Wi-Fi is the documented path.

smartthings.note: SwitchBot's pages we saw do not mention SmartThings for this model.

home_assistant.note: The product page lists Home Assistant. Home Assistant's SwitchBot Bluetooth docs list the original Lock Pro, not necessarily this variant.

hubRequired.note: This variant has built-in Wi-Fi and Matter; the original SwitchBot Lock Pro (without Matter Enabled) needs a SwitchBot Hub for Matter.

localControl.note: No SwitchBot source states local-only control.

lockFit.note: Fits over the existing thumb-turn of Euro profile, UK oval, Swiss round and knob cylinders.

keypad.note: Keypad access needs a separate accessory, sold in the Touch and Vision combos.

power.note: Dual rechargeable AB packs; one keeps powering the lock while the other charges.

summary: The SwitchBot Lock Pro Matter Enabled is the Matter version sold in Europe. It has built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and speaks Matter over Wi-Fi without a SwitchBot hub. SwitchBot's page lists Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home and Home Assistant. It fits over the thumb-turn of European-style cylinders and runs on rechargeable battery packs.
caveats: The original SwitchBot Lock Pro, without Matter Enabled, has no built-in Matter or Wi-Fi and needs a SwitchBot Hub.
Matter exposes lock and unlock only.
Keypad access needs a separate accessory.
